board_note: Scores are projected goals until final. Moneylines are DraftKings via the NHL API; fair odds are the model's no-vig price. Times in your local zone.
method_html:
Expected goals

Our own xG model: a logistic regression on every unblocked shot in the NHL's play-by-play (distance, angle, shot type, rebounds, rush chances, power play / shorthanded). Currently trained on 125,400 shots. xG measures chance quality, which predicts future scoring better than goals or raw shot counts.

Team strength

Opponent-adjusted offense and defense from regulation, non-empty-net xG and goals, fit by weighted ridge regression (recent games weighted 0.985× per day; shrunk toward 60% of last season). Blended as margin sources: our xG 35%, MoneyPuck xG 25%, goals 15%, Elo 25%.

MoneyPuck

Team expected goals and goalie GSAx from MoneyPuck.com (data used with credit, non-commercial). Their xG model adds shooter talent and adjusts for flurries, score state and venue. Team xG for/against per game this season is shrunk toward last season by 10 games and used as a fourth margin source. Each goalie's GSAx is a 50%/50% blend of MoneyPuck's and ours.

Goalies

Goaltending is the most decisive single position. Each goalie's goals saved above expected (GSAx) per unblocked shot over this season and last (60% weight), shrunk by 1,500 shots toward average. The starter is ESPN's listed probable goalie once posted; before that, the team's most frequent recent starter, or the backup when the starter played the night before. xG-based strength gets the full goalie effect; goals and Elo, which already include the usual goalie, get the difference vs the team's baseline.

Schedule and home ice

Home ice 0.2 goals of margin (~54% home win rate). Second night of a back-to-back costs 0.25 goals (~5% win probability).

Game simulation

Regulation goals are Poisson; a team leading by one late scores into the empty net 22% of the time (by two: 10%); ties go to 3-on-3 overtime (60% decided, in proportion to scoring rates) and then a shootout. That gives win, puck-line (±1.5) and total probabilities and fair odds.

Picks

Moneyline value: model win probability vs DraftKings odds published through the NHL's own API. EV tiers: lean 2.5%+, play 5.0%+, strong 8.0%+. Totals are flagged at 3%+ EV. Records are kept in units (1 unit per pick). Confidence weighs whether our xG, MoneyPuck, goals and Elo each see value on the side, EV, line movement and data quality. Weights and home ice are refit weekly to graded games.

Data: NHL public API (schedule, play-by-play, odds), MoneyPuck.com (team xG, goalie GSAx), ESPN (probable goalies). For entertainment only.
subtitle: Expected-goals, goalie-adjusted NHL moneylines

terms.record_note: Picks lock at the last moneyline before puck drop and are graded straight up and in units (1 unit per pick).
